children: On the heels of a 7% rally in SOL, preceding 7-day tracking window, Ron Sade, CEO of Solmate Infrastructure PLC (NASDAQ: SLMT) (“Solmate” or the “Company”), believes that it is still undervalued and sees a potential path towards continued market momentum over the next year. Sade is inviting the company's investors to Solana's flagship event in Singapore,
, hosted alongside TOKEN2049, where he will present his thesis on Solana's value appreciation in depth.
According to Solmate's public dashboard, as of the last trading day the company holds approximately 1.24 million SOL tokens, valued at an estimated $125 million.

Solmate Infrastructure PLC (NASDAQ: SLMT) is building next-generation digital infrastructure spanning blockchain and staking. The Company is focused on creating long-term shareholder value through the ownership, operation, and optimization of mission-critical digital infrastructure assets.
